description: We are Fara3net El Fadaa (Pharaohs of Space), a passionate team combining Node.js, Angular, and UI/UX design. We aim to transform NASA data into interactive solutions for Mars exploration and mission planning. We welcome teammates skilled in GIS, data analysis, scientific research, and 3D visualization. Together, we innovate, learn, and turn bold ideas into meaningful solutions.
summary:
MARSWAY is an interactive Mars exploration planning platform designed to help astronauts and mission planners make better-informed decisions when exploring the Martian surface. Our team developed a web-based solution that allows users to discover Martian geographic locations, select exploration destinations, generate and compare candidate routes, and review estimated mission requirements such as distance, travel time, oxygen consumption, and terrain-related risks.

The platform also includes a simulated walking navigation experience that displays the selected route, checkpoints, and mission progress. By combining geographic exploration, route planning, and mission simulation in one accessible interface, MARSWAY demonstrates how digital tools can support safer and more efficient exploration planning. Our vision is to help make future human exploration of Mars smarter, more understandable, and more resource-aware.
details:
MARSWAY is an interactive web-based platform designed to support planning and decision-making for future Mars surface exploration missions.

How It Works

MARSWAY allows users to search for Martian geographic locations and explore named surface features through an interactive map. Users can select an exploration destination and generate multiple candidate routes to compare different exploration possibilities.

The platform displays estimated mission-planning indicators, including route distance, travel time, oxygen consumption, energy requirements, and terrain-related risk indicators. After selecting a preferred route, users can start a simulated walking mission. The navigation interface displays the selected path, checkpoints, simulated astronaut position, and mission progress.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Exploring Mars presents significant challenges, including unfamiliar terrain, limited resources, long travel distances, and astronaut safety. MARSWAY addresses these planning challenges by bringing geographic exploration, route comparison, and resource estimation into one accessible platform.

Its intended impact is to demonstrate how interactive digital tools can help mission planners understand exploration options, evaluate estimated mission requirements, and make more informed decisions before a surface mission.

Technology and Tools

  • React.js and JavaScript for the frontend.
  • Node.js and Express.js for backend development.
  • MongoDB and Mongoose for database integration.
  • Leaflet and React Leaflet for interactive maps.
  • NASA and USGS planetary geographic resources for Martian location information and elevation references.
  • Git and GitHub for version control and source-code hosting.
  • Vercel for frontend deployment.
  • OpenAI Codex and ChatGPT for development assistance, code review, debugging, and technical guidance.

Creativity and Design Considerations

MARSWAY combines geographic discovery, candidate route generation, and simulated astronaut navigation into a single exploration workflow. Instead of presenting isolated map information, it connects destination selection with route comparison and mission-progress visualization.

During development, our team considered astronaut safety, oxygen availability, travel distance, estimated mission duration, terrain-related risks, and the importance of presenting complex information through a clear and intuitive interface.

The current route calculations and navigation are simulations based on modeled estimates, not actual astronaut telemetry or fully validated terrain-aware pathfinding. Our future goal is to integrate direct elevation and slope analysis to improve route assessment and exploration safety.
